final: WITH overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(s.modindex) as overall_avg_modindex FROM signals s JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE s.modindex IS NOT NULL), group_stats AS (SELECT t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile, AVG(s.modindex) as avg_modindex, AVG(s.phaseshiftdeg) as avg_phaseshiftdeg FROM signals s JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE s.modindex IS NOT NULL AND s.phaseshiftdeg IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile), filtered_groups AS (SELECT gs.weathprofile, gs.avg_modindex, gs.avg_phaseshiftdeg, oa.overall_avg_modindex FROM group_stats gs CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE gs.avg_modindex > oa.overall_avg_modindex) SELECT weathprofile, AVG(avg_modindex) as avg_modindex_per_weather, AVG(avg_phaseshiftdeg) as avg_phaseshiftdeg_per_weather, AVG(avg_modindex - (SELECT overall_avg_modindex FROM overall_avg)) as avg_above_overall FROM filtered_groups GROUP BY weathprofile ORDER BY weathprofile
